title: Media Refilling
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Select pipette and plate format
steps.instruction: Choose the pipette you wish to use and specify the cell‑culture plate format (24‑, 96‑, or 384‑well). Compatibility with the selected labware will be determined automatically.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Add your custom labware definitions to the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware.
Select the labware files with a .json extension (upload if needed).

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the Python protocol script to the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Select and upload the file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App calibration workflow.

substeps.instruction: Follow the on‑screen instructions for each piece of labware.
Refer to the OT App support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Start protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to execute the media removal and re‑addition protocol.
